Title: Rotisserie-Style Chicken Gyros with Homemade Tzatziki
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Spiced Chicken | 500 g | chicken thigh |  | 000047
- Spiced Chicken | 100 ml | Protein Yoghurt |  | 000641
- Spiced Chicken | 30 g | lemon |  | 000130
- Spiced Chicken | 20 ml | olive oil |  | 000378
- Spiced Chicken | 1 tsp | Garlic Powder |  | 000643
- Spiced Chicken | 1 tsp | Ground Onion |  | 000644
- Spiced Chicken | 1 tsp | oregano |  | 000251
- Spiced Chicken | 1 tsp | ground cumin |  | 000278
- Spiced Chicken | 1 tsp | ground paprika |  | 000290
- Spiced Chicken | 5 g | salted butter |  | 000211
- Spiced Chicken | 2 g | ground black pepper |  | 000285
- Homemade Tzatziki | 200 ml | Protein Yoghurt |  | 000641
- Homemade Tzatziki | 1 pcs | Cucumber |  | 000642
- Homemade Tzatziki | 10 g | garlic |  | 000112
- Homemade Tzatziki | 5 g | dill |  | 000249
- Homemade Tzatziki | 15 g | lemon |  | 000130
- Pita and Assembly | 320 g | pita |  | 000340
- Pita and Assembly | 100 g | lettuce |  | 000079
- Pita and Assembly | 100 g | tomatoes |  | 000093
- Pita and Assembly | 50 g | onion |  | 000111

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Spiced Chicken | Prep |  | SAFETY: Wash hands before and after handling raw poultry. Slice chicken thighs into thin, 1cm strips.
2. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Grate the cucumber using a box grater and place in a clean kitchen towel; squeeze forcefully to remove all liquid.
3. Pita and Assembly | Prep |  | Thinly shred the lettuce and slice the tomatoes and onions into thin rounds or half-moons.
4. Spiced Chicken | Prep |  | In a large mixing bowl, combine the yoghurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, ground onion, oregano, cumin, and paprika.
5. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Mince the fresh garlic and finely chop the dill leaves.
6. Pita and Assembly | Cook |  | Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat and warm each pita bread for about 45 seconds per side until soft and pliable.
7. Spiced Chicken | Prep |  | Add the chicken to the marinade, ensure every piece is coated, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
8. Homemade Tzatziki | Prep |  | Whisk the yoghurt with the garlic, dill, and lemon juice until smooth.
9. Pita and Assembly | Serve |  | Spread 2 tablespoons of tzatziki in the center of a warm pita.
10. Spiced Chicken | Cook |  | Preheat your oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
11. Homemade Tzatziki | Serve |  | Fold in the dry cucumber shreds and refrigerate until the chicken is ready.
12. Pita and Assembly | Serve |  | Top with a handful of chicken, lettuce, tomatoes, and onions; roll tightly and serve immediately.
13. Spiced Chicken | Cook |  | Spread the chicken in a tight single layer and roast for 20-25 minutes until deep brown and slightly charred at the edges.
14. Spiced Chicken | Serve |  | Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then roughly chop it to create varying textures.
